description: Revoke one unused invite by join_token (URL or raw token). The invite can no longer be joined. Used invites stay spent. The minting seat, or another seat in this Space that may invite, may revoke. Does not revoke the calling seat. REST POST /v1/spaces/{id}/invites/revoke. Destructive. Not idempotent.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. A string you generate once per intended action (a UUID is good) and repeat on retry. A retry with the same key and arguments returns the first result instead of acting twice; the same key with different arguments is refused. Kept 24 hours.

invite_url.description: Invite URL to revoke (alternative to join_token).

join_token.description: Invite URL (https://.../join/<token>) or the raw token.

name: revoke_invite
title: Revoke invite
